description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 14.03.2022 to 20.03.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation.
